faqs.question: Which IPMAT coaching has the best mock test series in India?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks PW Live #1 when the live IPMAT SKU ships a dense mock calendar, then Rodha, Career Launcher, IMS, Tutor Uncle, Aapt Prep, and T.I.M.E.

faqs.question: How many IPMAT mocks should I take before the exam?
faqs.answer: Most shortlist aspirants sit 30–50 full-length papers across the season, with weekly sectionals in weak areas. Ramp slowly in foundation months.

faqs.question: Are IMS SimCAT papers the same as IPMAT mocks?
faqs.answer: No. SimCAT is a CAT product. Ask for IPMAT mocks by name on the fee card.

faqs.question: Does PW Live always sell IPMAT mocks?
faqs.answer: Not always. Open pw.live and confirm a live IPMAT cart item—core catalogue is JEE/NEET.

faqs.question: Can I buy only mocks from these institutes?
faqs.answer: Some brands sell test-series-only SKUs. Ask for a mock-only fee card; classroom packs usually bundle live hours you may not use.
